Ghost tokens, owner transport and the exact unpaid endpoints

Use Canonical definitions throughout. The canonical foundation supplies positive MEX, injectivity, strict diagonal maximality, seeded-column nonreuse, diagonal/blocker disjointness, future-freeze and victim propagation. This supplement proves the stated finite identities and injections; it supplies no asymptotic cancellation assumption.

Recursively choose a same-host blocker service after both the current token date and all earlier chosen dates. This yields an injective forward assignment. Different hosts give different cells. Selected blockers need not be free B0B_0B0​, and delays/crossings are uncontrolled. The hypothesis on the physical host is essential; mortality of another service host is not ignored.

What remains unpaid

All these proofs keep their actual host, owner, token multiplicity and date. They do not prove a nonnegative victim gate, direct-Q A1, bounded crossing load, uniform square-root-window unmatched count or pointwise Q=o(n)Q=o(n)Q=o(n). An identity of signed inventories is not an estimate of its absolute terms.
